title: Enhancing mechanical performance of Ti2ZrNbHfVAlx refractory high-entropy alloys through laves phase
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a high-purity argon atmosphere with a vacuum degree of 3 × 10−3 Pa, using mechanical and molecular pumps to prevent oxidation. The high-purity elements (≥99.9%) were cleaned using ultrasonic waves in anhydrous ethanol for 20 min to remove impurities. Each ingot was melted at least eight times and turned over after each melt to ensure consistent chemical composition.
